summary.text: Frederica Wilson represents Florida's 24th Congressional District, covering parts of North Miami-Dade and southern Broward counties, and was elected to the U.S. House of Representatives in 2010.

paragraphs.text: Her office describes her as a former educator, elementary school principal, school board member and state legislator, and as founder of the 5000 Role Models of Excellence Project.
She serves on the Transportation and Infrastructure and Education and Workforce committees.
